guidance.title: Amabwiriza
guidance.introduction: Iyi pulatefomu ihuza abagira uruhare mu kubungabunga ibidukikije n'ibigo bishaka Amanota za karuboni zemejwe. Niba uhinga ibihingwa cyangwa utera ibiti bifasha kugabanya ihumana ry'ikirere, iyi sisitemu igufasha gukorera amafaranga binyuze mu bikorwa byawe.
guidance.step1_description: Ongeraho UPI yawe kugira ngo wemeze ko ubutaka ari ubwawe. Ibi byizera ubunyangamugayo n'amakuru yizewe.
guidance.step2_description: Fata amafoto agaragara neza y'ibihingwa cyangwa ibiti byawe bigabanya ibyotsi bya karuboni. Uyashyireho kugira ngo yemerwe.
guidance.step3_description: Nyuma yo gusuzumwa, ibikorwa byawe byo kubungabunga ikirere bibyara Amanota zishingiye ku bipimo byemejwe.
guidance.step4_description: Ibigo bigura Amanota kugira ngo bigabanye ibyotsi byabyo. Wowe winjiza amafaranga mu ikimotomoto cyawe cyahujwe.
guidance.contribution: Uruhare rwawe ni ingenzi. Buri giti, buri gihingwa, buri metero kare y'ubutaka ifasha kugabanya ihumana ni intambwe iganisha ku hazaza heza. Urakoze gukora impinduka!

admin.faq_ai_scoring: Sisitemu y'amanota y'Amanota ikoresha AI ikora ite?
admin.faq_ai_scoring_answer: Sisitemu ya AI isesengura inyandiko zoherejwe n'amakuru y'umukoresha mu kwemeza ubunyangamugayo bw'ubusabe bw'Amanota. Igenzura ko inyandiko ari umwimerere, ikagereranya amakuru y'umukoresha, n'ibyago bishobora kubamo.
admin.faq_farmer_docs: Ni izihe nyandiko zikenewe mu kwemeza umuhinzi?
admin.faq_farmer_docs_answer: Abahinzi bagomba gutanga: Icyemezo cy'Ubutaka/Icyangombwa cy'Ubutaka, Amafoto y'Umurima ya Vuba, Inyandiko z'Umusaruro (Amezi 3 ashize), n'Icyemezo cy'Aho batuye.
admin.faq_create_listing_answer: Jya kuri Igurishwa ry'Amanota > Kora Urutonde Rushya. Uzuza izina ry'urutonde, hitamo icyiciro, andika umubare n'igiciro cy'imwe. Reba agaciro kose ushyire hanze.
admin.faq_commission_answer: Kominisiyo ishingiye ku cyiciro: Umuhinzi (5%), Amashyiga Arondereza (6%), Imodoka Zivanze (4%), Ubucuruzi (7%). Aya akurwaho mu gihe cyo kugurisha byikora.
admin.faq_wallet_source: Amanota ziri mu kimotomoto cy'ubuyobozi zituruka he?
admin.faq_wallet_source_answer: Zituruka ku bakoresha bemejwe bazibona binyuze mu bikorwa byabo. Sisitemu ibika izi nguzanyo igihe habayeho imicungire no kugurisha.
admin.faq_payouts_answer: Kwishyura bigabanywa bishingiye ku ijanisha ry'uruhare rw'icyiciro n'igenamiterere ry'amafaranga.
admin.faq_manage_users_answer: Muri Abakoresha Sisitemu, ushobora kureba bose biyandikishije, ukayungurura ukurikije icyiciro n'imiterere.
admin.faq_user_statuses_answer: Akora: Yemejwe. Bitegereje: Hategerejwe kwemezwa. Ahagaritswe: Konti yabujijwe. Ntikora: Umukoresha ntiyakozwe iminsi 60+.
